title: per-feature advisor-nudge debt counter and per-row clearing
action: Per 9e5eda5b (plan S2). In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/supervisor.rs add a debt fn mirroring feature_dissent_debt's shape: count advisor-nudge rows whose derived feature matches AND that have no clearing decision. Clearing DIVERGES from the dissent-deferral tag+feature escape (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/dissent.rs ~:536-552) on purpose: a clearing decision is tagged advisor-nudge AND carries the row id in its decision text (DecisionFilters.text matching, packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/decisions/read.rs DecisionFilters ~:475-483) so one decision clears exactly one row — feature-level clearing is the rejected alternative, per plan. A decision missing the row id clears nothing. The fn is pure read over the two stores (423871d7: records alone). TDD inline tests: two unanswered rows, clear one, the other still counts; feature-less rows count against nothing.

truths: A decision tagged advisor-nudge naming a row id clears exactly that row's debt
Two unanswered rows with one cleared leaves one counting
A row with no derived feature counts against no feature
